# GIF encoder

[gifenc](https://github.com/mattdesl/gifenc) 1.0.3, MIT. Source pinned to commit `27db5b982dba701ca440b55ea36fad3999040973`; license preserved in [gifenc-LICENSE.txt](gifenc-LICENSE.txt).

`gifenc.js` is a browser IIFE built from upstream `src/index.js` using the repository's esbuild 0.25.12 with bundle/minify enabled, global name `CanranGif`, and a CommonJS export footer for the album bundle. No upstream install scripts were run.

The same local encoder is packaged with course assets and bundled into the authenticated album. Export requires no CDN, upload, or server rendering.

Bundled file SHA-256: `ad6349affd39b8b1c23dcd8e6c0bd9b4cbd23987a45ee2e60a1bffb5be30deff`.
